services.name: Floor consult
services.story: Floor consult, $35 at the showroom; a card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee; paid at the showroom desk.

services.name: Floor consult
services.story: Floor consult, $35; nothing taken; a YES books it; paid at the showroom desk.

services.name: Floor preview session
services.story: Floor preview session, $55, paid in full when booking; credited to the floor if Alex orders an install.

services.name: Whole-home floor plan
services.story: Whole-home floor plan, $140; a $40 deposit now; the $100 rest at the showroom desk.

services.name: Pattern layout
services.story: Pattern layout, priced from Alex's photos at $90 (Sam OKs it); a card saved for the $20 fee; paid at the showroom desk.

services.name: Floor match
services.story: Floor match, priced at the showroom after a $25 consult; a card saved for the $20 fee; paid at the showroom desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Danny and Hugo (estimator and crew lead)

services.name: Wood floor install
services.story: Wood floors, 594 sq ft: the $89 measure visit, nothing taken; Danny's $9,200 written quote; the contract, a $920 deposit, $3,370 when the wood arrives; the last $4,910 on the bill Rosie texts.

services.name: Wood floor install
services.story: The same floors, but Sam bills the deposit, the wood payment and the last payment his own way; Rosie sends nothing about money.

services.name: Wood floor install
services.story: The same floors, with a card saved for the $89 measure visit fee when he books.

services.name: Laundry room floor
services.story: A laundry room floor priced from photos at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it); a signed contract; a 25% deposit of $160; the rest on the bill.

services.name: Board repair
services.story: Board repair, $179 from the list (or a garage floor sealing); a card saved for the $89 fee; Rosie texts the bill after the job.

services.name: Buff and recoat
services.story: Buff and recoat, $150 from the list, paid in full when booking; nothing more after.

questions_before_times: What's on the floor now? (carpet, tile, vinyl, wood, not sure)
Which rooms, and about how big?
What floor would you like? (wood, vinyl plank, tile, carpet)
safety_stop: part of a floor has caved in or dropped, cracking sounds under foot, a hole someone could fall through
a gas smell, sparking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
license: if: a home improvement or contractor license for the company, where the state's form requires one. Some states license flooring only above a job size, or only for some floor types (hard floors but not carpet). Some license none.
